name: Merchants Bank of Alabama
description: We are Merchants Bank. Our purpose is to point people forward. We do this by offering financial tools that provide solutions to help our customers go forward, not only financially, but in life. Merchants Bank of Alabama, a division of SouthPoint Bank, has become Cullman County's go-to locally owned bank by going way out of our way. It's an approach to banking that goes way back to 1907 when we opened in Hanceville, Alabama. Since then we've made a point of changing with the customer. Not just the times. As banking got more impersonal, we offered local decision-makers with real power, long-time employees with a real connection to customers and a person on the other end of your telephone call. Unlike large banks, we're personally, not just financially invested in our communities, with employees and officers that dedicate real time to their towns' charities and causes. Our way of local banking built relationships that ended up building great communities. We've helped open local pharmacies and volunteer fire departments, construction companies and manufacturing plants that employ many of our customers. Our Ag Lending has helped keep Cullman County an agricultural powerhouse and family farming a thriving local tradition. And, we have thrived along with our communities. Now, as a division of SouthPoint Bank, we have approximately $1.8 billion in assets and 11 branches. But our greatest asset, our reputation, makes us the go-to bank in the local markets we serve. In a world of mega-banks, The Merchant's Way still towers. As more big-name banks moved into our communities, we kept our commitment to remain a local community bank, which has kept us a local leader. The Merchants Way has never been about size, but about what is big with our customers. Discover the power of banking with a local bank.
